name: Deployment-Oriented Deepfake Detection Benchmark
description: An evaluation suite that measures deepfake detection models' performance in deployment-relevant scenarios beyond simple accuracy metrics.
reputation: An emerging, deployment-focused benchmark with limited adoption so far but growing interest for realistic deepfake evaluation.
notes: Focuses on deployment scenarios (domain shifts, adversarial examples); dataset may be limited in size and diversity relative to real-world scale; non-LLM benchmark; common to report multiple metrics (AUC, accuracy, F1); risk of saturation on synthetic subsets.
